verdict.rationale: An event-driven rules engine is a fair capability for a docs platform to ship, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents user-defined rules or triggers that fire actions on events. Auto translations, the agent flagging outdated content, Git Sync and auto-generated RSS feeds are fixed built-in behaviors or adjacent features, not configurable event-to-action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
